📺 High Potential (2024–Present)

High Potential follows Morgan Gillory, a brilliant single mother of three whose extraordinary intelligence and remarkable observational skills unexpectedly lead her into the world of criminal investigations. While working as a cleaning lady for the Los Angeles Police Department, Morgan notices a crucial mistake in a murder case, impressing detectives with her ability to recognize hidden patterns and uncover clues that experienced investigators have overlooked. Her discovery earns her an opportunity to work as a consultant alongside Detective Adam Karadec, whose disciplined approach frequently clashes with Morgan’s unconventional methods. As they investigate mysterious murders, complicated crimes, and shocking secrets, Morgan struggles to balance her demanding new career with raising her children and searching for answers about her missing former partner. Starring Kaitlin Olson, Daniel Sunjata, Javicia Leslie, and Judy Reyes, the series delivers clever mysteries, unexpected twists, hilarious moments, and emotional storytelling about intelligence, motherhood, determination, and the importance of thinking differently.

🎭 Genre: Crime • Drama • Mystery • Comedy

⭐ IMDb: 7.6/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 43 minutes per episode • TV-14

🎥 Creator: Drew Goddard

📺 Seasons: 3 (third season announced)

📚 Based On: The French television series HPI (Haut Potentiel Intellectuel).

📺 Where to Watch: ABC • Hulu (United States)

source_details.synopsis: High Potential is an American crime comedy drama television series created by Drew Goddard for ABC. It is based on the 2021 Franco-Belgian television series HPI. The series stars Kaitlin Olson as Morgan Gillory, an intellectually gifted cleaning woman who becomes a police consultant. Also starring are Daniel Sunjata as Morgan's partner Adam Karadec and Judy Reyes as Selena Soto, the head of their unit. The series premiered on September 17, 2024. In January 2025, the series was renewed for a second season which premiered on September 16, 2025.
